tagline: Precision Engineered Solutions for Aerospace, Defense and Industrial Markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Backlog is the primary indicator of future growth for RBC, driven by long-term contracts in aerospace and defense, high-margin segments with low short-term cyclicality.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of unfilled but customer-confirmed orders.
kpis.description: Backlog reached $940.7M as of March 29, 2025, up 14.5% year-over-year, reflecting sustained demand in strategic segments.
kpis.signal: Strong backlog growth, supported by commercial aerospace and marine defense.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated company revenue for a fiscal period.
kpis.description: Revenue totaled $1,636.3M for fiscal year 2025 (fiscal year ended March 29, 2025), up 4.9% year-over-year, driven by recovery in commercial aerospace (+13.3%) and defense (+15.9%).
kpis.signal: Moderate growth driven by aerospace and defense.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of sales, expressed as a percentage.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Research and development spending in absolute value.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets such as machinery or plants.

kpis.name: Number of Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €4.69B in the latest year

kpis.name: Aerospace and Defense Segment Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by products destined for aerospace and defense markets.
kpis.description: Aerospace and Defense segment sales reached $592.8M in FY2025, up 14.1% versus FY2024, driven by commercial aerospace recovery (+13.3%) and increased defense demand (+15.9%). This segment represents 36.2% of total net sales.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in a high-margin segment, driven by commercial aerospace recovery and rising defense demand.

kpis.name: Industrial Segment Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from products destined for industrial markets.
kpis.description: Industrial sales remained flat at $1,043.5M in FY2025 (+0.2%), with OEM declines (-2.1%) offset by modest distribution and aftermarket gains (+1.4%). This segment represents 63.8% of total net sales.
kpis.signal: Virtually flat growth, pressured by energy and semiconductor markets but supported by distribution and aftermarket.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic or technological lever in its current segments.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced algorithms in the FY2025 10-K
No mention of AI-related products or services
Strategy centered on mechanical engineering, precision bearings, and physical components
